name: Ageha
source:
"You idiot! you can’t touch the Princess without permission!!"

The guardian of the Red Peony Kamon, and the Butterfly  under Leon.
In a daring reverse relationship of Master and support with Leon.
Like a wild beast tamer, she tames Leon.


[from [url=http://cannonette.tumblr.com/post/90743940677/reine-des-fleurs-side-characters]cannonette[/url]]
